description: GENUS ONLY. A goal for the agent to develop a faculty for expressing itself in different REGISTERS and PERSONAS, learned by example and by reading TVTropes/Wikipedia. No runner is supplied: the agent's drive loop picks this frontier, finds no faculty that moves it, consults the teacher on HOW, and AUTHORS the faculty itself (order-4 self-extend). This seed gives it the goal + the genus concepts + a placeholder to escalate from.

microtheory.name: expression_world
microtheory.description: the agent expressing the same content in different registers/personas (formal, casual, pirate, surfer, ...), learned from exemplars it reads

attrs.name: expression_world
attrs.description: express content in a learned register/persona

attrs.name: register
attrs.definition: the level/style of language chosen to suit the situation and audience (formal, casual, intimate, ...)

attrs.name: persona
attrs.definition: a characteristic voice/style of expression a speaker adopts (e.g. pirate, surfer, butler); a register with identifying markers

attrs.name: express_in_persona
attrs.definition: render the same meaning/speech-act in the surface forms and markers characteristic of a chosen persona/register

attrs.name: express_persona_placeholder
attrs.comment: PLACEHOLDER with no executor — it does not work; it exists so the frontier engages, stalls, and the agent AUTHORS the real faculty via order-4 self-extend.

attrs.gap_text: I have no way to express myself in different registers/personas; I should learn it from exemplars (TVTropes self-demonstrating definitions, Wikipedia) and by example.
